criteria.reason: The workout exercise menu includes “Skip Exercise” while logging is active.
Selecting it opens a confirmation modal before applying the skip.
The existing sets endpoint accepts skipped status, and the client submits every set with status “skipped”.
An exercise whose sets are all skipped displays a “Skipped” label, with a separate partial-completion condition.
The menu offers “Resume Exercise” for a skipped exercise and clears its skipped statuses.
The existing sets endpoint handles marking sets skipped and supports clearing them to resume.
The diff contains no new server test for skip or unskip.
The diff contains no new client test for the skip UI.
The reported server and client test suites both pass.
The added UI copy is direct and contains no exclamation marks.
